tests.name: normal_nonmanaged_agent_can_receive_utf8
tests.detail: A normal foreground controlled process is not gated by the managed-start readiness flag; Chinese prompt reaches actual agent.prompt and transcript echo.

tests.name: fullscreen_enters_landscape_with_system_rotation_locked
tests.detail: Fullscreen requests landscape with system auto-rotation disabled; decoder source remains 1080p.

tests.name: operation_pinch_zooms_without_remote_click_or_scroll
tests.detail: Actual two-pointer touchscreen pinch doubles viewport scale in operation; no host click, right click or wheel event.

tests.name: zoom_and_pan_click_maps_to_source_pixels
tests.detail: After 2x zoom and a 120/-60 pixel viewport pan, a calculated screen touch reaches source desktop (1100,600) within two pixels.

tests.name: trackpad_two_finger_tap_is_one_right_click
tests.detail: Two-pointer tap generates exactly one host right-click.

tests.name: trackpad_parallel_fingers_scroll_without_click
tests.detail: Parallel two-finger translation sends wheel input with no tap or right-click.

tests.name: direct_mode_ignores_letterbox_taps
tests.detail: A direct touch in the fitted image letterbox does not click the host.

tests.name: orientation_buttons_work_both_ways
tests.detail: Orientation override is observed by composition; manual portrait and landscape work with system auto-rotation off.

tests.name: viewport_rotation_and_pip_reuse_one_1080p_decoder
tests.detail: One 1920x1080 decoder configuration across explicit portrait / landscape and system PiP return.

tests.name: app_creates_and_starts_real_codex_without_submitting_a_prompt
tests.detail: New session from the Android app creates a distinct project workspace and starts installed Codex. No prompt or model task is submitted; provider first-run setup is not auto-approved.

tests.name: terminal_controls_reach_current_agent_pane
tests.detail: Visible terminal Down / Enter controls send to the actual selected public pane; controlled choice records one rejection, no command runs.

tests.name: failed_connection_keeps_settings_and_reason_visible
tests.detail: A deliberately closed SSH port fails in place with a visible translated reason and a diagnostic-copy action.

tests.name: connection_retry_recovers_without_key_or_trust_reset
tests.detail: Correcting the port reconnects and reuses saved SSH device identity and host trust.

tests.name: real_model_reply_and_structured_chat
tests.detail: Installed Codex answered the benign no-tools connectivity prompt; the selected herdr session identity yields actual assistant/user bubbles, not terminal inference.

tests.name: disconnect_reconnect_reuses_same_persistent_agent
tests.detail: Disconnecting phone SSH preserves backend foreground PID, terminal ID and provider session. Reconnect restores conversation without a provider/session setup action or extra workspace.
